records.failureSummary: Added test/persist.test.mjs with 8 AC-numbered tests for the FR1 persistence primitives in src/persist.mjs. Each test uses its own isolated temp directory via mkdtemp and cleans up in t.after. Coverage: [AC-01] loadData on a missing file returns exactly { items: [], nextId: 1 }; [AC-02] loadData on truncated/invalid JSON returns the empty fallback and does not throw; [AC-03] loadData on structurally invalid payloads (number, string, null, array, items not an array, nextId not a number, nextId null) each returns exactly { items: [], nextId: 1 }; [AC-04] loadData returns the exact persisted items and nextId for valid content; [AC-05] saveData creates a missing nested parent directory (nested/deeper/data.json) and round-trips; [AC-06] saveData leaves no temp file behind (target dir contains only data.json); [AC-07] a second saveData replaces previous contents and loadData returns the new data; [AC-08] saveData propagates an error for an unwritable path and leaves no temp files. Every corruption case asserts the exact fallback { items: [], nextId: 1 }. I demonstrated the red state first using a scratch stub of the pre-implementation module (the placeholder throws "loadData/saveData 尚未实现"): tests in the red state were 8 run / 0 passed / 8 failed. The earlier AC-08 passed vacuously against the placeholder because assert.rejects accepted any thrown error, so I strengthened it to require a real filesystem error code (typeof error.code === string), after which all 8 tests failed in red. I then removed the scratch harness and ran the tests against the real implementation: test/persist.test.mjs is 8 passed, 0 failed, 0 errors; full npm test is 9 passed, 0 failed (includes the pre-existing app test); npm run lint and npm run build are clean. No product code was modified. fixTaskType: NONE.
